protocol_notes.primary_scope: Read-only shadow validation on public SatNOGS observations; no jobs are submitted.
protocol_notes.station_selection: High-volume stations in the frozen v3 observations that were connected and available at registration, fixed before prospective outcomes.
protocol_notes.target_selection: The frozen v3 target cohort, fixed before prospective outcomes.
protocol_notes.weather: Forecast snapshots are captured before passes; finalized NASA POWER data may be used only in a separately labeled retrospective sensitivity analysis.
protocol_notes.hardware: SatNOGS antenna type/range snapshots are valid only from their capture time. Gain and system noise remain missing unless supplied by a versioned local station record.
protocol_notes.causal_boundary: A shadow run tests calibration and operational stability, not causal scheduler yield improvement.
